import numpy as np, torch, model, inspect
print(inspect.signature(model.load))
torch.manual_seed(0)
B=2048
c=torch.rand(B).numpy().astype(np.float32); xi=torch.randn(B,2).numpy().astype(np.float32)
res={}
for v in ["v0","v3","v4"]:
    try: net=model.load(v)
    except Exception as e: print(v,e); continue
    a=model.decode(net,xi,c); a=a[0] if isinstance(a,tuple) else a
    res[v]=np.asarray(a)
ref=res["v0"]
# reference typicality: nn distance to v0 cloud at similar c
torch.manual_seed(1); xi2=torch.randn(B,2).numpy().astype(np.float32)
a2=model.decode(model.load("v0"),xi2,c); a2=np.asarray(a2[0] if isinstance(a2,tuple) else a2)
def nnd(A):
    d=np.sqrt(((A[:,None,:2]-a2[None,:,:2])**2).sum(-1)+ (4*(c[:,None]-c[None,:]))**2)
    return d.min(1)
base=nnd(ref); thr=np.quantile(base,0.98)
for v,A in res.items():
    d=nnd(A); print(v,"offdist share",(d>thr).mean(),"moved",np.mean(np.linalg.norm(A-ref,axis=1)>0.1))

import numpy as np, torch, model
net=model.load(); neg=model.negatives()
uids=[4,7,32,128,131,143,158]
rows=[int(np.where(neg['uid']==u)[0][0]) for u in uids]
b=np.load('export/basins.npz')
print('bad',b['bad'][rows],'thr',b['thr'][rows],'eps',b['eps'][rows])
torch.manual_seed(0)
T=[]
for u,i in zip(uids,rows):
    c=float(neg['c'][i])
    xi=np.random.randn(512,2).astype(np.float32)
    a=model.decode(net,torch.tensor(xi),torch.full((512,),c))
    a=a.detach().numpy() if hasattr(a,'detach') else np.asarray(a)
    inb=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,a)).astype(bool)
    # also check in other members' basins
    bas=model.basin(i); 
    good=a[~inb]
    d=np.linalg.norm(good-neg['a'][i],axis=1)
    # typical: take median of 10 nearest good samples' ... use nearest real sample with local density
    order=np.argsort(d)[:15]
    # choose the one with highest density among good samples
    dens=[(np.linalg.norm(good-g,axis=1)<0.3).sum() for g in good[order]]
    j=order[int(np.argmax(dens))]
    T.append(good[j])
    print(u,i,round(c,3),neg['a'][i],'inb share',inb.mean().round(3),'basin center',np.asarray(bas['pts']).mean(0) if isinstance(bas,dict) else None,'target',good[j],'dist',d[j].round(2),'dens',max(dens))
T=np.array(T,dtype=np.float32); np.save('tgt1.npy',T); print(T)
